title: add JSONSchema strict response_format with improved errors and OpenAI compatibility
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds first-class JSONSchema-based structured output to the response_format API with a strict validation mode, improved error reporting, and an OpenAI-compatible adapter. Motivation: customers need deterministic, machine-readable outputs that fail loudly when models deviate from expected structure; strict validation enables safe production use for downstream consumers and tool/function calling. This PR implements: 1) response_format: {type: "jsonschema", schema: <jsonschema>, strict: true|false} parsing and enforcement; 2) a validator module that runs post-generation to validate/either accept, coerce (best-effort), or reject outputs depending on strict mode and configured fallback policies; 3) standardized error payloads (validation_errors, path, expected_type, actual_value_preview) surfaced in-stream and in final responses; 4) an OpenAI-compatibility layer that maps our structured-output errors into the familiar OpenAI response_format fields and error codes; 5) small streaming stability improvements to ensure partial validation logs don't break chunked responses. The description below lists changes, tests, rollout notes, and migration guidance. Checklist: - [x] API schema + server validation implementation - [x] OpenAI compatibility adapter - [x] streaming-safe error emission (partial/terminal events) - [x] comprehensive unit + integration tests - [x] docs and examples updated - [x] migration notes and deprecation warnings for legacy response_format behaviors Compatibility: new response_format values are opt-in; default behavior unchanged. Strict mode: when strict=true, invalid outputs cause the request to return a 400-style structured error with validation details unless a fallback policy is configured (e.g., return best-effort with warnings or route to fallback model). Error messages: structured, machine-consumable, and human-friendly strings suitable for portal logs and SRE alerts. Testing: unit tests cover schema edge-cases (additionalProperties, patternProperties, oneOf/anyOf), streaming chunk reconciliation, and OpenAI adapter mappings. Integration tests exercise tool/function calling flows where tools expect a precise JSON payload. Migration: small SDK updates (Python/TS) will add convenience helpers for constructing the response_format payload; server will log a deprecation warning for legacy implicit-structured-output behavior for two releases before removing. See release_notes for user-facing summary.
